metadata.title: The mass and velocity anisotropy of the Carina, Fornax, Sculptor and Sextans dwarf spheroidal galaxies

notes: No eligible stars are identified. The paper studies the Carina, Fornax, Sculptor and Sextans dwarf spheroidal galaxies and unnamed samples of member and rejected interloper stars; it does not identify an individual star as a Galactic unbound candidate, nor does it present follow-up of a previously identified Galactic unbound candidate (T:p1-b5, T:p2-b4, T:p2-b7).
